Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Malkavians are, if anything, more deranged and dangerously unpredictable than their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} counterparts, embracing madness as both weapon and worldview in service of the Sword of Caine.

Disciplines: Auspex, Dementation, Obfuscate

Advantage: All Malkavians gain a free level of Awareness.

Disadvantage: Every Malkavian is insane: all Malkavian characters suffer from a permanent derangement of some sort.

Organization: Malkavian antitribu are valued by the sect for their unsettling insight and unpredictability, often serving as oracles, agitators, or wildcards within their packs.
